Yugo Takahashi (Japanese: 高橋裕吾 Takahashi Yūgo) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Takahashi was born sometime on November 13 in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of Kail, one of the Invincible Pokémon Brothers, during , as well as in Pokémon Chronicles. Takahashi is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
